listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 45m², Centar, Kolašin
listing.description_text: Objekat u izgradnji pozicioniran u samom srcu Kolašina, okružen mnoštvom kafea, restorana, parkova i igrališta. U neposrednoj blizini nalaze se i pošta, dom zdravlja, supermarketi, autobuska stanica i ostali sadržaji koji u mnogome doprinose ugodnom boravku turista kao i svakodnevnim životnim potrebama. Posebna pažnja posvećena je odabiru modernih i kvalitetnih materijala koji su u kombinaciji sa tradicionalnim principima gradnje karakterističnim za ovo podneblje. U skladu sa tim, završna fasadna obloga su u jednom delu talpe od termotretiranog drveta dok je preostali deo fasade prirodni kamen debljine od 5-8cm. U delu koji se obradjuje termotretiranim drvetom, preko zidova od 20cm se postavlja termoizolacioni sloj debljine 15cm preko čega se predvidja sloj za provetravanje od 5cm i kao završni sloj pomenuto termotretirano drvo montrirano na za to predvidjenu podkonstrukciju. Zidovi čiji je finalni sloj kamen su takodje debljine 20cm i sa spoljašnjem delu se preko zida izradjuje sloj betonskog platna.Podovi na svim terasama se oblažu protivkliznom keramikom i izoluju adekvatnom hidroizolacijom. Dostupne nekretnine u sklopu kompleksa: - jednosobni stanovi od 44-45-46m2 - dvosobni stanovi od 70m2 i 90m2 - poslovni prostor od 234m2 Cijena iznosi od 2500-2600€/m2.
listing.description_text_en: Property under construction located in the very heart of Kolašin, surrounded by many cafes, restaurants, parks, and playgrounds. In the immediate vicinity there are also a post office, health center, supermarkets, bus station, and other amenities which greatly contribute to a pleasant stay for tourists as well as daily life needs. Special attention has been paid to the selection of modern and quality materials which are combined with traditional construction principles characteristic of this region. Accordingly, the final facade cladding in one part consists of thermally treated wood panels, while the remaining part of the facade is natural stone with a thickness of 5-8cm. In the part treated with thermally treated wood, a 15cm thick thermal insulation layer is installed over the 20cm walls, over which a 5cm ventilation layer is provided, and as a final layer, the aforementioned thermally treated wood is mounted on its designated substructure. Walls whose final layer is stone are also 20cm thick, and on the exterior part, a layer of concrete canvas is applied over the wall. Floors on all terraces are covered with non-slip ceramic tiles and insulated with adequate waterproofing. Available properties within the complex: - one-bedroom apartments from 44-45-46m2 - two-bedroom apartments from 70m2 and 90m2 - commercial space of 234m2 The price ranges from 2500-2600€/m2.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 59m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
listing.title_text_en: Sale, two bedroom apartment, 59m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
listing.description_text:
Objekat je pozicioniran na jednoj od najljepših lokacija u Tivtu. Riječ je o mirnoj lokaciji, na svega 800metara od mora, dok je od centra grada udaljena svega 1 kilometar. Objekat je koncipiran tako, da je svojom dužom stranom orijentisan ka moru, da bi svi stanovi imali otvoren pogled na grad i more. Objekat svojom arhitekturom i formom prati savremen način izgradnje i finalne obrade stambenih objekata. Struktura stanova u ob- jektu, sa mogućnošću objedinjavanja više stambenih jedinica u jednu, budućim korisnici- ma pruža pregršt mogućnosti u odabiru svog doma.
U podzemnim etažama organizovan je cjelokupan mirujući saobraćaj za potrebe korisnika ovog objekta. Pažljivo odabranim sadnicima visokog i niskog rastinja, parterno uređenje oko objekta biće detaljno ozelenjeno, kako bi objekat dodatno ušuškali i oplemenili... Osim navedenog, u parternom uređenju predviđena je izgradnja bazena za korisnike obog objekta...
listing.description_text_en:
The building is positioned in one of the most beautiful locations in Tivat. It is a quiet location, only 800 meters from the sea, while it is only 1 kilometer away from the city center. The building is designed so that its longer side is oriented towards the sea, so that all apartments have an open view of the city and the sea. With its architecture and form, the building follows modern construction methods and the final finishing of residential buildings. The structure of apartments in the building, with the possibility of combining several residential units into one, provides future users with a wealth of options in choosing their home.
In the underground floors, all stationary traffic is organized for the needs of the users of this building. With carefully selected tall and low-growing plants, the ground-level landscaping around the building will be thoroughly greened, to further nestle and enhance the building... In addition to the above, the construction of a swimming pool is planned in the ground-level landscaping for the users of this building...

listing.description_text:
NA PRODAJU ILI ZAMJENA – PORODIČNO IMANJE U VALJEVSKOJ LOZNICI, NADOMAK VALJEVA
Na prodaju prostrano porodično imanje smješteno u mirnom i prirodnom ambijentu Valjevske Loznice, na svega nekoliko minuta od Valjeva.
Imanje se prostire na 3 hektara (30.000 m²) i obuhvata plodnu zemlju, šumu, podignute šljivike, stambeni objekat površine 180 m², kao i dodatnih 100 m² pomoćnih objekata, uključujući pečenjaru.
Kuća raspolaže sa 4 spavaće sobe, kupatilom i parkingom za četiri vozila.
Imanje izlazi na seosku rječicu i posjeduje sopstveni bunar, a dostupni su i gradski vodovod, javna rasvjeta i dobra putna povezanost.
Lokacija je udaljena svega nekoliko minuta od magistralnog puta i lokalne pruge, 7–8 minuta vožnje od centra Valjeva, a oko 30 minuta od Beograda. U blizini se nalaze i banja Vrujci i druge atraktivne turističke lokacije.
Mirno okruženje, priroda i velika površina zemljišta pružaju odlične mogućnosti za porodični život, odmor, poljoprivredu, voćarstvo ili razvoj seoskog turizma.
Moguća zamjena za nekretninu na crnogorskom primorju, uz dogovor.
listing.description_text_en:
FOR SALE OR EXCHANGE – FAMILY ESTATE IN VALJEVSKA LOZNICA, NEAR VALJEVO
For sale, a spacious family estate located in the peaceful and natural environment of Valjevska Loznica, just a few minutes from Valjevo.
The estate spans 3 hectares (30,000 m²) and includes fertile land, forest, established plum orchards, a residential building with an area of 180 m², as well as an additional 100 m² of ancillary buildings, including a BBQ house.
The house features 4 bedrooms, a bathroom, and parking for four vehicles.
The estate borders a village river and has its own well, and city water supply, public lighting, and good road connections are available.
The location is just a few minutes from the main road and local railway, 7–8 minutes drive from the center of Valjevo, and about 30 minutes from Belgrade. Nearby are also Banja Vrujci and other attractive tourist locations.
The peaceful environment, nature, and large land area provide excellent opportunities for family life, vacation, agriculture, fruit farming, or the development of rural tourism.
Possible exchange for a property on the Montenegrin coast, by agreement.

The building is built with high quality, in an excellent location, suitable for living or investment. Possibility of agreement regarding renting out on a daily, monthly, and yearly basis.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, jednosoban stan, 52m², City Kej, Podgorica
listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 52m², City Kej, Podgorica
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se stan u naselju City Kej, ukupne površine 52 m², uz garažu koja se prodaje posebno. Stan je moderno uređen, funkcionalnog rasporeda i ne zahtijeva dodatna ulaganja – idealan za odmah useljenje ili kao investicija za izdavanje.
Nekretnina se nalazi na atraktivnoj lokaciji, u blizini svih bitnih sadržaja (prodavnice, škole, gradski prevoz), te pruža udoban i praktičan način života. Cijena na upit.
listing.description_text_en:
An apartment is for sale in the City Kej neighborhood, with a total area of 52 m², with a garage that is sold separately. The apartment is modernly arranged, with a functional layout and requires no additional investment – ideal for immediate move-in or as a rental investment.
The property is located in an attractive location, near all essential amenities (shops, schools, public transport), and offers a comfortable and practical way of life. Price on request.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, dvosoban stan, 61m², Pod Goricom, Podgorica
listing.title_text_en: Sale, two bedroom apartment, 61m², Pod Goricom, Podgorica
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se dvosoban stan u luksuznom i mirnom kompleksu ispod Gorice, u blizini hotela Ambasador. Stan je dostupan na prizemlju, prvom i drugom spratu, površine od 61,05 m², i odlikuje ga odlična iskoristivost prostora.
Smješten je u mirnom kraju, a postoji i mogućnost kupovine garažnog mjesta., Lux, Novogradnja
listing.description_text_en: A two-bedroom apartment is for sale in a luxurious and peaceful complex below Gorica, near the Ambasador hotel. The apartment is available on the ground floor, first and second floor, with an area of 61.05 m², and is characterized by excellent space utilization. It is located in a quiet area, and there is also the possibility of purchasing a parking space., Lux, New construction

listing.description_text:
Moderna vila na prodaju – 243 m²Vila 1 predstavlja savremenu troetažnu nekretninu ukupne površine 243 m² (184 m² neto), projektovanu za udoban život u mirnom okruženju planinske prirode.
Prostrani i svijetao dnevni boravak sa open-space kuhinjom povezan je sa terasom kroz velike panoramske prozore, koji prostoru daju dodatnu svjetlost i osjećaj otvorenosti. Master spavaća soba sa sopstvenim kupatilom i bibliotečkim kutkom pruža visok nivo privatnosti i idealno mjesto za opuštanje, dok je donji nivo predviđen za odlaganje i vinski podrum.
Vila je opremljena svim neophodnim za komforan život, uključujući visoke plafone od 3.15 m, grijanje na pelet, privatnu BBQ zonu i parking za tri vozila. Plac površine oko 600 m² nudi mogućnost uređenja privatnog vrta ili zone za odmor na otvorenom.
Dodatne opcije uključuju ugradnju jacuzzija, spoljnog kamina ili dječijeg igrališta, kao i izradu enterijerskog projekta po želji kupca.
Naša preporuka za ljubitelje prirode, privatnosti i savremenog života., Lux, Miran kraj, Penthouse
listing.description_text_en:
Modern villa for sale – 243 m²Vila 1 represents a contemporary three-story property with a total area of 243 m² (184 m² net), designed for comfortable living in a peaceful mountain nature environment.
The spacious and bright living room with an open-space kitchen is connected to the terrace through large panoramic windows, which give the space additional light and a feeling of openness. The master bedroom with its own bathroom and library corner provides a high level of privacy and an ideal place for relaxation, while the lower level is intended for storage and a wine cellar.
The villa is equipped with everything necessary for comfortable living, including high ceilings of 3.15 m, pellet heating, a private BBQ zone, and parking for three vehicles. A land plot of approximately 600 m² offers the possibility of arranging a private garden or an outdoor relaxation area.
Additional options include the installation of a jacuzzi, an outdoor fireplace, or a children's playground, as well as the creation of an interior design project according to the buyer's wishes.
Our recommendation for lovers of nature, privacy, and contemporary living., Lux, Quiet neighborhood, Penthouse

listing.title_text: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 278m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 278m², Porto Montenegro, Tivat
listing.description_text:
Predstavljamo Dukley kvalitet u srcu Porto Montenegra – lokaciju iz mašte podignuta na potpuno novi nivo.
Projekat Dreams by Dukley razvija ekskluzivni stambeni kompleks koji čine tri stambene zgrade, uz krovni bazen koji povezuje dva objekta. Svaka zgrada nudi luksuzne studije, apartmane i prostrane jedinice, dizajnirane do perfekcije uz najviši kvalitet završne obrade i opremanja. Završetak izgradnje planiran je za jul 2027. godine.
Budućim vlasnicima, Dreams by Dukley nudi izuzetnu investicionu priliku na jednoj od najtraženijih lokacija u Boka Kotorska, uz Dukley privilegije, profesionalno upravljanje nekretninom, concierge i sigurnosne usluge dostupne 24/7, kao i garantovani povrat investicije od 6% godišnje., Lux, Odlična investicija
listing.description_text_en: We present Dukley quality in the heart of Porto Montenegro – an imaginary location elevated to a completely new level. The Dreams by Dukley project is developing an exclusive residential complex consisting of three residential buildings, with a rooftop pool connecting two of the buildings. Each building offers luxury studios, apartments, and spacious units, designed to perfection with the highest quality finishes and furnishing. Completion of construction is planned for July 2027. For future owners, Dreams by Dukley offers an exceptional investment opportunity in one of the most sought-after locations in Boka Kotorska, with Dukley privileges, professional property management, concierge and security services available 24/7, as well as a guaranteed return on investment of 6% annually., Lux, Excellent investment

listing.description_text:
Objekat (izgradnja vile) se nalazi u selu Krašići, Opština Tivat, na prvoj liniji iznad mora u Boki Kotorskoj, okružen malim vilama. Supermarketi i restorani su na pješačkoj udaljenosti.
Ukupna površina placa je 506 m2, dozvoljena je izgradnja vile od 350 m2. Trenutno je podignut prvi sprat zgrade. Sastoji se od tri etaže otvorenog rasporeda. Prema projektu, objekat je mini-hotel sa šest apartmana, ali bi se mogao završiti kao porodična kuća. Kupac će doneti odluku. Prema pravu svojine, imanje ima svoj betonski pristanište na obali sa površinom od još 160 m2.
Trenutno postoji odobren projekat, plaćene su sve potrebne komunalne naknade. Iskopana je jama i izgrađeni podrum i potporni zidovi. Struja, gradska voda i kanalizacija su obezbeđeni do ivice lokacije.
listing.description_text_en:
The property (villa construction) is located in the village Krašići, Tivat Municipality, on the first line above the sea in Boka Kotorska, surrounded by small villas. Supermarkets and restaurants are within walking distance.
The total area of the land plot is 506 m2, construction of a 350 m2 villa is permitted. Currently, the first floor of the building has been erected. It consists of three open-plan floors. According to the project, the property is a mini-hotel with six apartments, but it could be finished as a family house. The buyer will make the decision. According to property law, the property has its own concrete pier on the coast with an additional area of 160 m2.
Currently, there is an approved project, all necessary utility fees have been paid. The pit has been excavated, and the basement and retaining walls have been built. Electricity, city water, and sewerage are provided to the edge of the site.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 100m², Kalimanj, Tivat
listing.description_text:
Dva stana u Tivtu, Kalimanj | 100 m² svaki | Garažno mjesto uključeno
Na izuzetnoj lokaciji u Tivtu, u mirnom i prestižnom naselju Kalimanj, nekoliko minuta hoda od mora i centra grada, prodaju se dva moderna stana, svaki površine 100 m². Ova nekretnina predstavlja idealnu priliku za porodični dom, ali i za investiciju. U neposrednoj blizini marine, centra grada i svih važnih sadržaja. Stanovi nude visok nivo udobnosti i komfora.
Objekat je projektovan tako da se savršeno uklopi u ambijent primorskog naselja, uz poseban fokus na estetiku, komfor i privatnost stanara.
Stanovi imaju odličnu prirodnu osvijetljenost i funkcionalan raspored, dok je korišćenje kvalitetnih materijala i opreme osigurano u svim fazama izgradnje. U prizemlju su obezbijeđena parking mjesta, a svaki stan posjeduje svoju terasu ili balkon sa pogledom na zelenilo. Izolacija objekta i energetska efikasnost dodatno doprinose komforu i uštedama na duži rok.
listing.description_text_en:
Two apartments in Tivat, Kalimanj | 100 m² each | Garage space included
In an exceptional location in Tivat, in the quiet and prestigious neighborhood Kalimanj, a few minutes' walk from the sea and the city center, two modern apartments are for sale, each with an area of 100 m². This property represents an ideal opportunity for a family home, but also for investment. In the immediate vicinity of the marina, city center, and all important amenities. The apartments offer a high level of comfort and convenience.
The building is designed to perfectly blend into the ambiance of the coastal settlement, with a special focus on aesthetics, comfort, and the privacy of residents.
The apartments have excellent natural light and a functional layout, while the use of quality materials and equipment is ensured in all construction phases. Parking spaces are provided on the ground floor, and each apartment has its own terrace or balcony with a view of the greenery. The building's insulation and energy efficiency further contribute to comfort and long-term savings.

listing.description_text:
Kompleks je pravi raj gde mediteranski dizajn vila i besprekorno uređen pejzaž stvaraju osećaj harmonije sa prirodom, sve dok uživate u blizini grada i udobnostima visokog životnog standarda.
OPREMA VILE:
* Fitnes i Spa * Privatni infiniti bazen u svakoj vili * Kamin na 2 sprata * Koncept otvorenog prostora i panoramski pogled na more * Spektakularan panoramski pogled na more sa zelenilom
INFASTRUKTURA:
* Ulaz samo za stanovnike * Parking i prostor za roštilj * Bioskop na otvorenom * Retko bilje i potoci bistre vode oko vila * Koncept otvorenog prostora * Amfiteatar za večeri poezije * Večernji časovi joge i istezanja na mesečini * 24/7 recepcija i obezbeđenje
listing.description_text_en:
The complex is a true paradise where Mediterranean villa design and impeccably landscaped scenery create a sense of harmony with nature, all while enjoying the proximity to the city and the comforts of a high standard of living.
VILLA AMENITIES:
• Fitness and Spa • Private infinity pool in each villa • 2-story fireplace • Open-space concept and panoramic sea view • Spectacular panoramic sea view with greenery
INFRASTRUCTURE:
• Residents-only entrance • Parking and barbecue area • Outdoor cinema • Rare plants and clear water streams around the villas • Open-space concept • Amphitheater for poetry evenings • Evening yoga and stretching classes under the moonlight • 24/7 reception and security

listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 42m², Topolica, Bar
listing.description_text:
U ponudi moderan stambeni kompleks savremene arhitekture, projektovan po visokim standardima gradnje i funkcionalnosti.
Objekat je spratnosti -2Po + Pr + 10, i sastoji se od dvije lamele (A i B), sa dvije podzemne etaže namijenjene garažama i ostavama. Stanarima su na raspolaganju recepcije, kao i 6 liftova, uz implementirane smart sisteme za dodatni komfor i sigurnost.
U ponudi su različite strukture stanova:
• jednosobni apartmani: 42,04 – 50,94 m²
• dvosobni apartmani: 83,18 m²
• penthausi: 103,72 – 113,23 m²
Već po cijeni 120.000€ se mogu kupiti jednosobni stanovi. U cijenu stana uključeno parking mjesto.
Kompleks se nalazi na atraktivnoj lokaciji, svega 950 m od centra Bara, na pravcu ka Ulcinju i Velikoj plaži.
listing.description_text_en:
On offer is a modern residential complex of contemporary architecture, designed according to high standards of construction and functionality.
The building has -2 underground floors + ground floor + 10 floors, and consists of two blocks (A and B), with two underground floors intended for garages and storage rooms. Receptions are available to residents, as well as 6 elevators, with implemented smart systems for additional comfort and security.
Different apartment structures are available:
• one-bedroom apartments: 42,04 – 50,94 m²
• two-bedroom apartments: 83,18 m²
• penthouses: 103,72 – 113,23 m²
One-bedroom apartments can be purchased starting from 120.000€. A parking space is included in the apartment price.
The complex is located in an attractive location, only 950 m from the center of Bar, on the way towards Ulcinj and Velika plaža.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 55m², Centar, Budva
listing.description_text:
Prodaje se stan na prvom spratu površine 55 m² u novom, modernom kompleksu u blizini Starog grada. Zgrada ima P+4S
Stan je svijetao, funkcionalan i moderno opremljen, idealan za porodični život ili kao investicija. Kompleks nudi kvalitetnu gradnju, mirnu lokaciju i blizinu plaže, restorana i svih sadržaja.
listing.description_text_en:
An apartment for sale on the first floor with an area of 55 m² in a new, modern complex near Stari grad. The building has P+4S.
The apartment is bright, functional, and modernly equipped, ideal for family life or as an investment. The complex offers quality construction, a quiet location, and proximity to the beach, restaurants, and all amenities.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, land lot, 5788m², Trebešin, Herceg Novi
listing.description_text:
Prodaju se započete vile u gruboj gradnji na placu površine 5.788 m², u naselju Trebesin, Herceg Novi. Lokacija se nalazi u neposrednoj blizini magistrale, u području koje ubrzano dobija na vrijednosti i prestižu, zahvaljujući blizini luksuznih kompleksa kao što su Porto Novi i Lazure Marina.
Na parceli je započeta izgradnja vila, pri čemu je svaka vila projektovana na oko 500 m² stambenog prostora, sa planiranim bazenom i prostranim dvorištem. Projekat je osmišljen sa fokusom na luksuz, komfor i savremeni način života, uz mogućnost da budući vlasnik završi objekte prema sopstvenim željama.
Sa placa se pruža otvoren i prelijep pogled na more, što dodatno doprinosi atraktivnosti ove nekretnine.
Udaljenost od mora iznosi oko 4 km, dok su Tivat Airport i Dubrovnik Airport udaljeni približno 25 km i 30 km.
listing.description_text_en:
Unfinished villas under rough construction are for sale on a land plot of 5,788 m², in the Trebesin neighborhood, Herceg Novi. The location is in the immediate vicinity of the main road, in an area that is rapidly gaining in value and prestige, thanks to its proximity to luxury complexes such as Porto Novi and Lazure Marina.
Construction of villas has commenced on the land plot, with each villa designed for approximately 500 m² of living space, with a planned swimming pool and a spacious courtyard. The project is designed with a focus on luxury, comfort, and modern lifestyle, with the option for the future owner to complete the properties according to their own wishes.
The land plot offers an open and beautiful sea view, which further adds to the attractiveness of this property.
The distance from the sea is approximately 4 km, while Tivat Airport and Dubrovnik Airport are approximately 25 km and 30 km away.

listing.description_text: Irina Residence u Tološima - prodaju garsonjere površine 34.15m², smještenu među zelenilom i u mirnom okruženju. Stan je prozračan i svijetao, sa funkcionalnim rasporedom i izlazom na terasu, što dodatno doprinosi osjećaju komfora. Podovi su završeni kvalitetnom keramikom i parketom, što upotpunjuje moderan i prijatan ambijent ovog prostora – idealnog za stanovanje ili investiciju. Projekat će biti završen do oktobra 2026. Ima obezbijedjeno parking mjesto.
listing.description_text_en: Irina Residence in Tološi - selling a studio apartment with an area of 34.15m², located amidst greenery and in a peaceful environment. The apartment is airy and bright, with a functional layout and access to a terrace, which further contributes to the feeling of comfort. The floors are finished with quality ceramics and parquet, which completes the modern and pleasant ambiance of this space – ideal for living or investment. The project will be completed by October 2026. It has a secured parking space.

listing.description_text:
Moderan luksuzni stambeni kompleks u Budva, smješten u naselju Dubovica Lux, na samo nekoliko minuta hoda od centra grada, Starog grada i plaže. U ponudi su studio, jednosobni, dvosobni i trosobni apartmani sa panoramskim pogledom na more.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, two bedroom apartment, 66m², Centar, Budva
listing.description_text:
Na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija na crnogorskom primorju, u srcu Budva, nude se premium stanovi na samom šetalištu, gdje se spoj luksuza, komfora i mediteranskog načina života osjeća na svakom koraku.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, ugostiteljski objekat, 20995m², Luštica, Herceg Novi
listing.title_text_en: Sale, hospitality venue, 20995m², Luštica, Herceg Novi
listing.description_text:
Prodaja zemljišta sa projektom hotela sa 5 zvezdica.
Zemljište se nalazi na crnogorskom poluostrvu Luštica, u najvećem zalivu na Jadranskom moru - na obali Boko Kotorskog zaliva, koji se naziva najjužnijim fjordom u Evropi, 10 minuta od tivatskog aerodroma.
Poslednji plac na samoj obali mora gde je još uvek moguće izgraditi hotel sa 5 zvezdica. Priroda ovde je luksuzna. Veličanstvene planine, azurno more. Usamljene uvale sa sitnim peščanim i šljunčanim plažama su raštrkane duž obale, a u okolini se nalaze borovi i maslinjaci, autentična sela, privatna imanja i vinogradi. Jednom rečju, idila.
Postavljeni su temelji za izgradnju područja Golf Residences. Svetski poznati igrač Geri Plejer je pozvan da razvije projekat golf terena. Ovde će biti izgrađen profesionalni teren sa 18 rupa, prvih 9 će biti otvoreno do kraja 2023. godine. Generalno, projekat je jedinstveni. Prema rečima stručnjaka, manje od 10% golf terena u svetu pruža mogućnost posmatranja mora sa bilo koje tačke.
Naselje Centrale će postati trgovački, administrativni i kulturni centar.
Tu će biti smeštene glavne gradske službe: obdanište, škola i zdravstveni centar, policijska i vatrogasna stanica, banka, pošta, autoservis i benzinska pumpa, autlet selo, konferencijski centar i sportski kompleksi. U naselju će biti uređeni novi parkovi, uređena šetališta, otvorene galerije, prodavnice i kafići na centralnom trgu.
Cena zemljišta je 9 447 750 e
Površina placa 20 995 m2
Ukupna površina kompleksa - 16 287 m2
HOTEL:
Ukupna površina nadzemnih etaža 8 382,34 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 5.956,10 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 14.338,44 m2
KUĆA ZA GOSTE:
Ukupna površina nadzemnih 1.620,60 m2 Ukupna površina podzemnih etaža 328,23 m2 Ukupna površina hotela 1 948, 83 m2
listing.description_text_en:
Sale of a land plot with a 5-star hotel project.
The land plot is located on the Montenegrin peninsula Luštica, in the largest bay on the Adriatic Sea - on the coast of Boko Kotorskog zaliva, which is called the southernmost fjord in Europe, 10 minutes from Tivat airport.
The last land plot directly on the seashore where it is still possible to build a 5-star hotel. The nature here is luxurious. Magnificent mountains, azure sea. Secluded coves with fine sandy and pebble beaches are scattered along the coast, and in the surroundings there are pine and olive groves, authentic villages, private estates and vineyards. In a word, an idyll.
Foundations have been laid for the construction of the Golf Residences area. World-renowned player Geri Plejer has been invited to develop the golf course project. Here, an 18-hole professional course will be built, the first 9 will be open by the end of 2023. Generally, the project is unique. According to experts, less than 10% of golf courses in the world offer the possibility of observing the sea from any point.
The Centrale settlement will become a commercial, administrative, and cultural center.
The main city services will be located there: kindergarten, school, and health center, police and fire station, bank, post office, car service, and gas station, outlet village, conference center, and sports complexes. New parks will be arranged in the settlement, arranged promenades, open galleries, shops, and cafes on the central square.
The price of the land plot is 9 447 750 e
Area of the land plot 20 995 m2
Total area of the complex - 16 287 m2
HOTEL:
Total area of above-ground floors 8 382,34 m2 Total area of underground floors 5.956,10 m2 Total area of the hotel 14.338,44 m2
GUEST HOUSE:
Total area of above-ground 1.620,60 m2 Total area of underground floors 328,23 m2 Total area of the hotel 1 948, 83 m2

O rezidenciji
Ovaj moderan stambeni projekat nalazi se u naselju Dubovica Lux u Budvi, na odličnoj lokaciji u blizini autobuske stanice, fakulteta i novog Mega Malla na Zaobilaznici. Udaljen je oko 7 minuta hoda od glavne autobuske stanice, 15 minuta od centra grada i oko 15 minuta od plaže.
Kompleks se sastoji od 39 stanova različitih struktura (studio, jednosobni, dvosobni i trosobni apartmani) i 40 garažnih mjesta. Stanarima su na raspolaganju recepcija i 24/7 obezbjeđenje, spa centar sa teretanom, saunom i jacuzzi-jem, spoljni grijani bazen, pool bar, restoran, dječije igralište, šatl prevoz do plaže i avantura park u neposrednoj blizini. Svi stanovi imaju pogled na more.
Objekat je projektovan u klasičnom stilu, južne orijentacije, sa velikim staklenim površinama koje obezbjeđuju puno prirodnog svjetla. U gradnji se koriste visokokvalitetni evropski ekološki materijali.
Stanovi se prodaju sa uključenim dizajnerskim enterijerom i kompletnim završnim radovima: spušteni plafoni, rasvjeta, dekorativni kamen, granit ili parket, opremljena kupatila sa italijanskom sanitarnom opremom, podno grijanje, smart sistem, aluminijumska stolarija i fasada od prirodnog kamena.
Planirani završetak radova je oktobar 2027. godine.

This modern residential project is located in the Dubovica Lux neighborhood in Budva, in an excellent location near the bus station, university, and the new Mega Mall on Zaobilaznica. It is about a 7-minute walk from the main bus station, 15 minutes from the city center, and about 15 minutes from the beach.
The complex consists of 39 apartments of various structures (studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments) and 40 parking spaces. Residents have access to reception and 24/7 security, a spa center with a gym, sauna, and jacuzzi, an outdoor heated pool, a pool bar, a restaurant, a children's playground, shuttle transport to the beach, and an adventure park in the immediate vicinity. All apartments have a sea view.
The building is designed in a classic style, south-facing, with large glass surfaces that provide plenty of natural light. High-quality European ecological materials are used in construction.
The apartments are sold with included designer interior and complete finishing works: suspended ceilings, lighting, decorative stone, granite or parquet, equipped bathrooms with Italian sanitary ware, underfloor heating, smart system, aluminum joinery, and a natural stone facade.
The planned completion of works is October 2027.

listing.title_text: Prodaja, trosoban stan, 282m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.title_text_en: Sale, three bedroom apartment, 282m², Budva, Crna Gora
listing.description_text:
Nekretnine, Crna GoraNa prodaju je luksuzan trosoban penthouse stan sa spektakularnim direktnim pogledom na more, smešten u prestižnom kompleksu Dukley Gardens, Budva.
Stan ima površinu od 282m², uz dodatak krovne terase od 235m², idealne za uživanje u panoramskim pogledima i opuštanje na otvorenom.
Ova nekretnina je kompletno završena i useljiva, pružajući vam mogućnost da se odmah uselite i uživate u svim pogodnostima koje nudi.
Postoji mogućnost kupovine ove nekretnine u kriptovaluti Bitcoin, čime se omogućava fleksibilnost u plaćanju.
Dukley Gardens je elitna nekretnina na jadranskoj obali u najslikovitijem mestu Crne Gore. Otkrijte Crnu Goru, zemlju ogromnih prirodnih bogatstava i najčistijeg mora, prirodnih ukusa i pažljivo očuvanih drevnih tradicija. Svaki dan, svaki minut će biti ispunjen harmonijom i lepotom. Od sjajnog izlaska sunca do romantičnog zalaska sunca, čekaju vas nezaboravni utisci koje ćete želeti da iskusite iznova i iznova. Dopustite sebi da se opustite u prostranom i udobnom domu, opustite se na plaži skrivenoj od radoznalih očiju, uživajte u gastronomskoj večeri na ogromnoj terasi sa panoramskim pogledom na Jadran.
Osmišljen od strane međunarodne grupe uglednih projektanata, renomiranih graditelja i nagrađivanih arhitekata, u saradnji sa vrhunskim kreativnim timom konsultanata za dizajn i tehnologiju, Dukley nudi izvanredne sadržaje i usluge. Sa pogledom na jednu od najlepših obala na svetu, ovaj kompleks ekskluzivnih rezidencijalnih vila spaja najmoderniju infrastrukturu, sofisticirani savremeni dizajn i vrhunske sadržaje, podižući ljestvicu kvaliteta primorskih rezidencijalnih kompleksa u Crnoj Gori.
Uz pomoć najsavremenije Smart Home tehnologije koja osigurava kompletnu bezbednost, stanari kompleksa Dukley Gardens mogu kontrolisati svoje stanove koristeći lične uređaje. Putem telefona ili tableta svaki stanar može upravljati osvetljenjem i klima uređajima, kao i multimedija sistemima i sistemima za bezbednost i nadzor u svom stanu.

listing.description_text:
Smještena u mirnoj i prestižnoj rezidencijalnoj zoni Gornje Gorice, predstavlja spoj moderne arhitekture, vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i sofisticiranog načina života. Ova ekskluzivna vila površine 231 m² projektovana je sa posebnim fokusom na funkcionalnost, privatnost i dugoročnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Prostran i svijetao enterijer karakterišu otvoreni koncept dnevnog boravka, velike staklene površine i obilje prirodnog svjetla tokom cijelog dana, stvarajući prijatan i elegantan ambijent za svakodnevni život.
Vila posjeduje privatnu wellness zonu koja uključuje grijani bazen sa masažnim mlazovima i luksuznu finsku KYRA saunu, pružajući potpuni osjećaj relaksacije i odmora u udobnosti sopstvenog doma.
Objekat je opremljen naprednim Smart Home sistemom koji omogućava jednostavno upravljanje rasvjetom, grijanjem, hlađenjem, sigurnosnim sistemima i ostalim funkcijama putem mobilnog telefona. Dodatni nivo sigurnosti obezbijeđen je HD video nadzorom, alarmnim sistemom, kontrolom pristupa i perimetarskom zaštitom.
Energetska efikasnost vile postignuta je savremenim sistemima kao što su podno grijanje sa toplotnom pumpom, multi-split i kanalni klima sistemi bez vidljivih unutrašnjih jedinica, kao i unaprijed pripremljena infrastruktura za solarne panele, što omogućava niže troškove energije i održiv način života.
U izgradnji i opremanju korišćeni su premium materijali i renomirani svjetski brendovi poput Porcelanosa keramike, Tarkett parketa, Hansgrohe AXOR i Geberit sanitarnih sistema, Villeroy & Boch opreme, Florim keramike i aluminijumske stolarije, garantujući vrhunsku estetiku, dugotrajnost i visoku tržišnu vrijednost nekretnine.
Lokacija vile pruža idealan balans između privatnosti i urbanog života.
listing.description_text_en:
Located in the quiet and prestigious residential zone of Gornja Gorica, it represents a blend of modern architecture, premium construction quality, and a sophisticated lifestyle. This exclusive villa with an area of 231 m² is designed with a special focus on functionality, privacy, and long-term property value.
The spacious and bright interior is characterized by an open-concept living room, large glass surfaces, and an abundance of natural light throughout the day, creating a pleasant and elegant ambiance for everyday life.
The villa has a private wellness zone which includes a heated pool with massage jets and a luxurious Finnish KYRA sauna, providing a complete sense of relaxation and rest in the comfort of your own home.
The property is equipped with an advanced Smart Home system which allows for easy control of lighting, heating, cooling, security systems, and other functions via mobile phone. An additional level of security is provided by HD video surveillance, an alarm system, access control, and perimeter protection.
The energy efficiency of the villa is achieved through modern systems such as underfloor heating with a heat pump, multi-split and ducted air conditioning systems without visible indoor units, as well as pre-prepared infrastructure for solar panels, which enables lower energy costs and a sustainable lifestyle.
Premium materials and renowned global brands were used in the construction and furnishing such as Porcelanosa ceramics, Tarkett parquet, Hansgrohe AXOR and Geberit sanitary systems, Villeroy & Boch equipment, Florim ceramics, and aluminum joinery, guaranteeing superior aesthetics, durability, and high market value of the property.
The villa's location provides an ideal balance between privacy and urban life.

listing.description_text:
Jedinstvena prilika za kupovinu premium obalnog zemljišta na jednoj od najpoželjnijih lokacija u Crnoj Gori
Smješteno u slikovitom naselju Lipci, u veličanstvenom Bokokotorskom zalivu, ovo izuzetno zemljište predstavlja jedinstvenu investicionu priliku u regionu poznatom po prirodnim ljepotama, ekskluzivnosti i rastućem tržištu luksuznih nekretnina.
Nekretninu čini više povezanih katastarskih parcela ukupne površine 17.235 m², koje zajedno formiraju prostrano imanje sa izuzetnim dugoročnim razvojnim i investicionim potencijalom.
Primarna lokacija
Smješteno uz put koji povezuje Risan i Nikšić Veći dio zemljišta nalazi se na manje od 100 metara od obale Jadranskog mora Okruženo impresivnim pejzažima Bokokotorskog zaliva Odlična povezanost sa Kotorom, Perastom, Tivtom, Porto Montenegrom i međunarodnim aerodromima Mirno okruženje koje pruža privatnost uz blizinu svih važnih sadržaja
Karakteristike nekretnine
Zemljište karakteriše uzdignut i pretežno kamenit teren, tipičan za autentični mediteranski pejzaž koji definiše Bokokotorski zaliv. Prirodna konfiguracija terena omogućava atraktivne vidikovce i jedinstven ambijent koji se rijetko nalazi u neposrednoj blizini mora.
Nekretnina obuhvata kombinaciju šumskog zemljišta, livada i prirodnog kraškog terena, pružajući jedinstven spoj ekološke vrijednosti i investicione atraktivnosti.
Planski status
Zemljište je obuhvaćeno Prostorno-urbanističkim planom Kotora i Prostornim planom posebne namjene za obalno područje Crne Gore.
Nekretnina se nalazi unutar strateški značajne obalne zone koja se prostire do 1.000 metara od obale i pozicionirana je u području predviđenom za buduće plansko uređenje i prostorni razvoj. Detaljne mogućnosti razvoja zavise od pribavljanja urbanističko-tehničkih uslova od nadležnih organa.
17.235 m² premium obalnog zemljišta Prestižna lokacija u Bokokotorskom zalivu Veći dio zemljišta nalazi se na manje od 100 metara od mora
Snažan dugoročni investicioni potencijal Odličan pristup putnoj infrastrukturi
listing.description_text_en:
Unique opportunity to purchase premium coastal land in one of the most desirable locations in Montenegro
Located in the picturesque settlement of Lipci, in the magnificent Bokokotorski zaliv, this exceptional land plot represents a unique investment opportunity in a region known for its natural beauty, exclusivity, and growing luxury real estate market.
The property consists of several connected cadastral land plots with a total area of 17,235 m², which together form a spacious estate with exceptional long-term development and investment potential.
Primary location
Located along the road connecting Risan and Nikšić A larger portion of the land is located less than 100 meters from the coast of Jadransko more Surrounded by impressive landscapes of Bokokotorski zaliv Excellent connectivity to Kotor, Perast, Tivat, Porto Montenegro, and international airports Peaceful surroundings providing privacy with proximity to all important amenities
Property characteristics
The land is characterized by elevated and predominantly rocky terrain, typical of the authentic Mediterranean landscape that defines Bokokotorski zaliv. The natural configuration of the terrain allows for attractive viewpoints and a unique ambiance rarely found in the immediate vicinity of the sea.
The property includes a combination of forest land, meadows, and natural karst terrain, providing a unique blend of ecological value and investment attractiveness.
Planning status
The land is covered by the Spatial-Urban Plan of Kotor and the Spatial Plan of Special Purpose for the Coastal Area of Montenegro.
The property is located within a strategically significant coastal zone extending up to 1,000 meters from the coast and is positioned in an area designated for future planning and spatial development. Detailed development possibilities depend on obtaining urban-technical conditions from the competent authorities.
17,235 m² premium coastal land Prestigious location in Bokokotorski zaliv A larger portion of the land is located less than 100 meters from the sea
Strong long-term investment potential Excellent access to road infrastructure

listing.description_text:
Predmetna nepokretnost nalazi se u području naselja Šipačno, u Opštini Nikšić, na mirnoj lokaciji udaljenoj približno 15 kilometara od centra grada i oko 2,7 kilometara od magistralnog puta, što omogućava povezanost sa širom saobraćajnom mrežom.
Ukupna površina zemljišta iznosi 18.413 m². Lokacija se odlikuje prirodnim ambijentom i predstavlja dio područja obuhvaćenog važećom prostorno-planskom dokumentacijom Opštine Nikšić.
Prema planskoj namjeni, zemljište se nalazi u zoni šumskih površina, koje su predviđene za očuvanje i unapređenje šumskog fonda, kao i za aktivnosti u funkciji gazdovanja šumama. U okviru ove zone dozvoljena je izgradnja objekata namijenjenih održavanju i unapređenju šumskih resursa, šumskih saobraćajnica, kao i planinarskih i lovačkih domova.
Nekretnina predstavlja interesantnu priliku za investitore i korisnike zainteresovane za zemljište većih površina u prirodnom okruženju, sa potencijalom za razvoj sadržaja usklađenih sa planskom namjenom i principima održivog korišćenja prostora.
listing.description_text_en:
The subject property is located in the area of the settlement Šipačno, in the Municipality of Nikšić, in a quiet location approximately 15 kilometers from the city center and about 2.7 kilometers from the main road, which allows connection to the wider transport network.
The total land plot area is 18,413 m². The location is characterized by a natural environment and represents a part of the area covered by the valid spatial planning documentation of the Municipality of Nikšić.
According to the planned use, the land plot is located in a zone of forest areas, which are intended for the preservation and improvement of the forest fund, as well as for activities related to forest management. Within this zone, the construction of facilities intended for the maintenance and improvement of forest resources, forest roads, as well as mountaineering and hunting lodges is permitted.
The property represents an interesting opportunity for investors and users interested in larger land plots in a natural environment, with the potential for developing content aligned with the planned use and principles of sustainable space utilization.

listing.description_text:
Predmetne nepokretnosti nalaze se na području Njeguša, u Prijestonici Cetinje, u neposrednoj blizini ulazno-kontrolnog punkta Nacionalnog parka Lovćen. Riječ je o atraktivnoj lokaciji prepoznatoj po izuzetnim prirodnim vrijednostima, autentičnom ambijentu i značajnom turističkom potencijalu.
Zemljište je organizovano u više prostornih cjelina, od kojih pojedine imaju direktan pristup lokalnim i regionalnim saobraćajnicama, uključujući putni pravac Kotor–Njeguši–Cetinje, dok se dio površina nalazi u prirodnom okruženju bez neposrednog pristupa javnim putevima.
Prema važećoj prostorno-planskoj dokumentaciji, zemljište obuhvata zone namijenjene stanovanju male gustine, poljoprivrednim površinama, šumama i ostalim prirodnim površinama. Dio lokacija posjeduje potencijal za izgradnju stambenih i pomoćnih objekata, kao i objekata u funkciji poljoprivredne djelatnosti, uz poštovanje urbanističko-tehničkih uslova i važećih planskih ograničenja.
Prirodno okruženje, blizina Nacionalnog parka Lovćen i dobra povezanost sa Cetinjem i Bokokotorskim zalivom daju ovoj nekretnini poseban investicioni značaj. Kombinacija različitih namjena zemljišta pruža mogućnost razvoja sadržaja usklađenih sa principima održivog korišćenja prostora, poljoprivrede i ruralnog turizma.
Zahvaljujući jedinstvenoj lokaciji u jednom od najprepoznatljivijih predjela Crne Gore, predmetne nepokretnosti predstavljaju interesantnu priliku za investitore i korisnike zainteresovane za razvoj projekata u skladu sa prirodnim i prostornim karakteristikama ovog područja.
listing.description_text_en:
The subject properties are located in the area of Njeguši, in the Capital City of Cetinje, in the immediate vicinity of the entrance control point of Lovćen National Park. It is an attractive location recognized for its exceptional natural values, authentic ambiance, and significant tourism potential.
The land is organized into several spatial units, some of which have direct access to local and regional roads, including the Kotor–Njeguši–Cetinje road, while some areas are in a natural environment without direct access to public roads.
According to the valid spatial planning documentation, the land includes zones designated for low-density housing, agricultural areas, forests, and other natural areas. Part of the locations have potential for the construction of residential and auxiliary buildings, as well as buildings for agricultural activities, with respect to urban-technical conditions and valid planning restrictions.
The natural environment, the proximity of Lovćen National Park, and good connectivity with Cetinje and Bokokotorski zaliv give this property special investment significance. The combination of different land uses provides the opportunity to develop content aligned with the principles of sustainable spatial use, agriculture, and rural tourism.
Thanks to its unique location in one of the most recognizable regions of Crna Gora, the subject properties represent an interesting opportunity for investors and users interested in developing projects in accordance with the natural and spatial characteristics of this area.

listing.description_text:

Izdaje se ekskluzivna luksuzna vila površine 400m², smještena u jednom od najprestižnijih i najtraženijih djelova Podgorice – Gorica C.
Vila se nalazi u mirnom, zelenom i elitnom okruženju, u neposrednoj blizini ambasada i rezidencijalnih objekata, što je čini idealnim izborom za ambasade, predstavništva, kompanije, rezidencijalnu namjenu ili luksuzan porodični život.
Nekretnina se prostire na placu površine 600m² i sastoji se od dva odvojena stambena dijela, pružajući visok nivo funkcionalnosti, privatnosti i fleksibilnosti u organizaciji prostora.
Donji nivo ima poseban ulaz i funkcioniše kao nezavisna stambena jedinica. Sastoji se od dvije prostorije, kupatila, vešeraja i direktnog izlaza u dvorište.
Gornji nivoi obuhvataju četiri prostrane spavaće sobe, veliki salon, dnevni boravak, trpezariju, kuhinju, galeriju iznad dnevnog boravka koja može služiti kao biblioteka, radni prostor ili kancelarija, dva kupatila i gostinjski toalet.
Vila raspolaže sa četiri terase, lijepo uređenim dvorištem, garažom i dodatnim parkingom za dva vozila ispred kuće. Grijanje i hlađenje obezbijeđeni su putem split sistema.

• Broj soba: 5+

listing.description_text_en:
FOR LEASE | Luxurious villa – Gorica C, Podgorica
An exclusive luxurious villa with an area of 400m² is for lease, located in one of the most prestigious and most sought-after parts of Podgorica – Gorica C.
The villa is located in a peaceful, green, and elite environment, in the immediate vicinity of embassies and residential buildings, which makes it an ideal choice for embassies, representative offices, companies, residential purposes, or a luxurious family life.
The property is spread on a land plot with an area of 600m² and consists of two separate residential units, providing a high level of functionality, privacy, and flexibility in space organization.
The lower level has a separate entrance and functions as an independent residential unit. It consists of two rooms, a bathroom, a laundry room, and a direct exit to the courtyard.
The upper levels comprise four spacious bedrooms, a large lounge, a living room, a dining room, a kitchen, a gallery above the living room which can serve as a library, workspace, or office, two bathrooms, and a guest toilet.
The villa features four terraces, a beautifully landscaped courtyard, a garage, and additional parking for two vehicles in front of the house. Heating and cooling are provided via a split system.
Basic information:
• Location: Gorica C, Podgorica
• House area: 400m²
• Land plot area: 600m²
• Number of rooms: 5+
• Number of bathrooms: 3
• Garage + additional parking for 2 vehicles
Rental price: 4.500 € monthly

listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 49m², Portonovi, Herceg Novi
listing.description_text:
Rezidencijalni kompleks sa pogledom na Bokokotorski zaliv
Smješten u Herceg Novom, u neposrednoj blizini prestižnog Portonovi rizorta i svega oko 200 metara od mora, ovaj savremeni rezidencijalni kompleks predstavlja atraktivnu priliku za život, odmor i investiranje.
Kompleks obuhvata 56 stambenih jedinica, sa jednosobnim (1+1) i dvosobnim (2+1) stanovima. Zahvaljujući atraktivnoj lokaciji i okolnoj izgradnji, stanovi nude otvoren pogled prema moru i Bokokotorskom zalivu.
Stanovi 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Cijena: 350.000 – 430.100 € Cijena zavisi od spratnosti i pozicije.
Sadržaji kompleksa
Stanovnicima i gostima na raspolaganju su brojni sadržaji:
• otvoreni i zatvoreni bazen
• moderna teretana
• tursko kupatilo i sauna
• prostor za odmor i kafić
• dječije igralište
• recepcija i obezbjeđenje
• otvoreni parking i podzemna garaža
• lift za automobile
• stanica za punjenje električnih vozila
• rezervni generator za kontinuirano snabdijevanje električnom energijom
Investiciona vrijednost
Kompleks je pogodan za kratkoročno i dugoročno izdavanje, kao i za privatno korišćenje. Kupcima koji nekretninu kupuju kao investiciju biće pružena podrška u procesu izdavanja i upravljanja rentiranjem.
Lokacija u neposrednoj blizini Portonovi rizorta, luksuznih vila, marine i hotela dodatno povećava atraktivnost nekretnine. Hotel One&Only nalazi se na približno 150 metara, dok je plaža udaljena oko 400 metara. U okolini se nalaze restorani, prodavnice, škole, parkovi i drugi sadržaji.
Finansiranje i plan plaćanja
Predviđen je fleksibilan model kupovine:
• 50% početnog učešća
• 50% kroz mjesečne ili kvartalne rate do 24 mjeseca
• dinamika plaćanja se može uskladiti sa individualnim dogovorom i fazom izgradnje
Dostupna je i mogućnost kreditnog finansiranja do 30% vrijednosti nekretnine putem partnerskih banaka Erste i Ziraat, uz planirano proširenje saradnje sa Adriatic bankom.
Šta je uključeno u cijenu
U cijenu stana uključeni su PDV i kuhinjski namještaj. Kuhinjski aparati nijesu uključeni.
Troškovi prenosa vlasništva, notarske i druge administrativne takse nijesu uključeni.
Parking se prodaje posebno:
• Otvoreno parking mjesto: 10.000 €
• Podzemno garažno mjesto: 30.000 €
Ova nekretnina predstavlja spoj luksuzne lokacije, savremenih sadržaja, pogleda na more i investicionog potencijala, pogodnog kako za vlastito korišćenje, tako i za prihod od izdavanja.
listing.description_text_en:
Residential complex with a view of Bokokotorski zaliv
Located in Herceg Novom, in the immediate vicinity of the prestigious Portonovi resort and only about 200 meters from the sea, this modern residential complex represents an attractive opportunity for living, vacation, and investment.
The complex includes 56 residential units, with one-bedroom (1+1) and two-bedroom (2+1) apartments. Thanks to the attractive location and surrounding construction, the apartments offer an open view towards the sea and Bokokotorski zaliv.
Apartments 1+1: 48,56 – 58,79 m² Price: 350.000 – 430.100 € The price depends on the floor and position.
Complex amenities
Numerous amenities are available to residents and guests:
• outdoor and indoor pool
• modern gym
• Turkish bath and sauna
• relaxation area and cafe
• children's playground
• reception and security
• outdoor parking and underground garage
• car elevator
• electric vehicle charging station
• backup generator for continuous electricity supply
Investment value
The complex is suitable for short-term and long-term rental, as well as for private use. Buyers who purchase the property as an investment will be provided with support in the process of renting out and rental management.
The location in the immediate vicinity of Portonovi resort, luxury villas, marina, and hotels further increases the attractiveness of the property. Hotel One&Only is located approximately 150 meters away, while the beach is about 400 meters away. In the surroundings, there are restaurants, shops, schools, parks, and other amenities.
Financing and payment plan
A flexible purchase model is foreseen:
• 50% initial down payment
• 50% through monthly or quarterly installments up to 24 months
• payment dynamics can be aligned with individual agreement and the construction phase
The possibility of loan financing up to 30% of the property value through partner banks Erste and Ziraat, with a planned expansion of cooperation with Adriatic bank, is also available.
What is included in the price
The apartment price includes VAT and kitchen furniture. Kitchen appliances are not included.
Costs of ownership transfer, notary, and other administrative fees are not included.
Parking is sold separately:
• Outdoor parking space: 10.000 €
• Underground garage space: 30.000 €
This property represents a combination of luxury location, modern amenities, sea views, and investment potential, suitable for both private use and rental income.

listing.description_text:
DVOSOBNI DELUXE APARTMAN
Predstavljamo ekskluzivne Deluxe rezidencije u okviru jednog od najluksuznijih rizorta u Kotoru, namijenjene kupcima koji žele prostranost, privatnost, hotelski servis i mogućnost ostvarivanja prihoda kroz profesionalni rental program.
Dvosobni Deluxe apartman raspolaže sa ukupno 159,2 m², od čega 95,6 m² čini unutrašnji prostor, dok čak 63,6 m² pripada privatnoj terasi.
Prostran dnevni boravak sa kuhinjom zauzima 38,6 m², master spavaća soba 17,0 m², druga spavaća soba 15,3 m², master kupatilo 7,0 m², a dodatno kupatilo 6,9 m². Ulazni prostor i hodnik dodatno doprinose funkcionalnosti rezidencije.
Apartman je potpuno namješten i dizajniran u savremenom mediteranskom stilu. Velike staklene površine pružaju obilje prirodne svjetlosti, dok privatna terasa od 63,6 m² predstavlja idealan prostor za uživanje, odmor i boravak na otvorenom.
Pogodnosti za vlasnike uključuju:
• Pristup spa i fitness centru • Bazen • Hotelske restorane uz rezervaciju • 24/7 concierge servis • Profesionalno upravljanje • Premium namještaj i opremu • Wi-Fi i kablovsku TV • Parking, gdje je primjenjivo • Prioritetni pristup resort sadržajima i iskustvima • Posebne vlasničke popuste
RENTAL PROGRAM
Rezidencija može biti uključena u hotelski rental program i predstavljena kao dio jedinstvenog 5★ hotelskog iskustva.
Hotelski operator preuzima marketing, rezervacije, komunikaciju sa gostima, čišćenje, održavanje i druge operativne aktivnosti.
U skladu sa zakonskim zahtjevima, najmanje 10 mjeseci godišnje predviđeno je za komercijalnu upotrebu.
CIJENA I USLOVI
Početna cijena: €490.000 + PDV
Cijena zavisi od sprata, orijentacije i veličine vanjskog prostora.
Plaćanje: 20% prilikom potpisivanja ugovora 4 jednake rate prema građevinskim fazama Puna uplata do maja 2027.
OGRANIČENA DOSTUPNOST
Dostupna su samo 4 dvosobna apartmana.
Rana kupovina omogućava izbor između dostupnih jedinica i korišćenje preferencijalnih uslova tokom privatne prodajne faze.
Za više informacija o dostupnosti, cijeni, poziciji apartmana i uslovima rental programa, kontaktirajte nas.
listing.description_text_en:
TWO-BEDROOM DELUXE APARTMENT
We present exclusive Deluxe residences within one of the most luxurious resorts in Kotor, intended for buyers who desire spaciousness, privacy, hotel service, and the possibility of generating income through a professional rental program.
The two-bedroom Deluxe apartment has a total of 159,2 m², of which 95,6 m² is interior space, while as much as 63,6 m² belongs to a private terrace.
A spacious living room with kitchen occupies 38,6 m², the master bedroom 17,0 m², the second bedroom 15,3 m², the master bathroom 7,0 m², and the additional bathroom 6,9 m². The entrance area and hallway further contribute to the functionality of the residence.
The apartment is fully furnished and designed in a contemporary Mediterranean style. Large glass surfaces provide abundant natural light, while the private terrace of 63,6 m² represents an ideal space for enjoyment, relaxation, and outdoor living.
Benefits for owners include:
• Access to spa and fitness center • Pool • Hotel restaurants by reservation • 24/7 concierge service • Professional management • Premium furniture and equipment • Wi-Fi and cable TV • Parking, where applicable • Priority access to resort amenities and experiences • Special owner discounts
RENTAL PROGRAM
The residence can be included in the hotel rental program and presented as part of a unique 5★ hotel experience.
The hotel operator takes over marketing, reservations, guest communication, cleaning, maintenance, and other operational activities.
In accordance with legal requirements, at least 10 months per year are allocated for commercial use.
PRICE AND CONDITIONS
Starting price: €490.000 + PDV
The price depends on the floor, orientation, and the size of the outdoor space.
Payment: 20% upon signing the contract 4 equal installments according to construction phases Full payment by May 2027.
LIMITED AVAILABILITY
Only 4 two-bedroom apartments are available.
Early purchase allows for choice among available units and the use of preferential conditions during the private sale phase.
For more information about availability, price, apartment position, and rental program conditions, contact us.

listing.description_text_en:

For sale a larger land plot near Ulcinj, only 800–900 m from Solana and about 2.5 km from Štoj and Velika plaža. The land plot has an excellent view, access via paved road, as well as available electricity and water.
A total of 140 land plots have been parceled, with an area of about 600 m² and more, with space for roads.
The first 31 land plots, with a total area of about 20,000 m², already have UTU conditions. On them, the construction of about 31 villas is possible, up to approximately 250 m² per building, with the possibility of combining land plots and building a hotel or another tourist complex.
The remaining about 75,000–80,000 m² represents additional development potential, where UTU conditions can be obtained in accordance with the investor's idea and project.

listing.description_text:
EKSKLUZIVNI TOWNHOUSE PROJEKAT
Predstavljamo vam ekskluzivan kompleks od 9 luksuznih townhouse vila, projektovanih za savršen spoj modernog dizajna, komfora, privatnosti i prirodnog okruženja.
Smešten na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, kompleks pruža panoramski pogled na Jadransko more, planine i Sveti Stefan. Mirna lokacija, visok standard gradnje i odlična povezanost sa najpoznatijim destinacijama čine ovaj projekat idealnim za luksuzno stanovanje, odmor ili investiciju sa potencijalom za profitabilno izdavanje.
ISTAKNUTA JEDINICA – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
Kompleks je organizovan u tri objekta – A, B i C – sa po tri townhouse jedinice, ukupno 9 ekskluzivnih vila. Svaka vila prostire se na četiri nivoa i pažljivo je osmišljena kako bi pružila maksimalnu funkcionalnost, privatnost i uživanje u panoramskom pogledu.
Glavne karakteristike vila:
• 4 prostrane spavaće sobe sa sopstvenim kupatilima
• 2 dnevne zone
• 2 potpuno opremljene kuhinje
• privatni bazen
• prostrane terase sa pogledom na more
• garaža za 2 automobila
• visoki plafoni od 3 m
• panoramski prozori visine 2,5 m
• video nadzor i interfon
• multi-split klima sistem
• optički internet
• sistem zaštite od požara
• centralno zagrevanje vode
• rezervni tehnički sistemi
VRHUNSKI STANDARDI GRADNJE
Arhitektura vila kombinuje savremenu estetiku sa prirodnim i kvalitetnim materijalima. Eksterijer karakteriše prirodni kamen, dok energetski efikasna aluminijumska stolarija i velike staklene površine obezbeđuju obilje prirodnog svetla i neometan pogled prema moru.
Enterijer je opremljen pažljivo odabranim materijalima visokog kvaliteta, uključujući hrastov parket u spavaćim sobama, vrhunsku keramiku i sanitarije renomiranog brenda Villeroy & Boch. Svaka vila poseduje kompletan smart tehnički i sigurnosni sistem.
PRIVATNI BAZEN
Privatni bazen predstavlja idealno mesto za opuštanje i uživanje tokom toplih letnjih dana. Opremljen je kompletnim sistemom za filtraciju, osvetljenje i održavanje, pružajući vlasnicima visok nivo komfora i privatnosti.
ATRAKTIVNA LOKACIJA
Projekat se nalazi u mirnom i privatnom okruženju, a istovremeno je odlično povezan sa najvažnijim destinacijama crnogorskog primorja:
• 5 minuta do Svetog Stefana
• 10 minuta do Budve
• 30 minuta do Porto Montenegra i Kotora
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Tivat
• oko 50 minuta do aerodroma Podgorica
USLOVI PLAĆANJA
• 5.000 € – rezervacija
• 10% – pri potpisu ugovora
• 30% – nakon završetka grubih radova
• 30% – nakon završetka finih radova
• 30% – po dobijanju upotrebne dozvole, umanjeno za iznos rezervacije
Ovaj projekat predstavlja izuzetnu priliku za kupce koji žele luksuznu rezidenciju na crnogorskom primorju, ali i za investitore zainteresovane za visokoprofitabilno turističko izdavanje.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – spoj savremenog luksuza, privatnosti i jedinstvenog pogleda na Jadran.
listing.description_text_en:
EXCLUSIVE TOWNHOUSE PROJECT
We present an exclusive complex of 9 luxury townhouse villas, designed for a perfect blend of modern design, comfort, privacy, and natural surroundings.
Located in one of the most attractive locations on the Montenegrin coast, the complex offers panoramic views of Jadransko more, mountains, and Sveti Stefan. A quiet location, high construction standards, and excellent connectivity to the most famous destinations make this project ideal for luxury living, vacation, or investment with potential for profitable rental.
FEATURED UNIT – TOWNHOUSE C-2 | 295 m²
The complex is organized into three buildings – A, B, and C – each with three townhouse units, totaling 9 exclusive villas. Each villa spans four levels and is carefully designed to provide maximum functionality, privacy, and enjoyment of the panoramic view.
Main characteristics of the villas:
• 4 spacious bedrooms with private bathrooms
• 2 living areas
• 2 fully equipped kitchens
• private pool
• spacious terraces with sea views
• garage for 2 cars
• high ceilings of 3 m
• panoramic windows 2.5 m high
• video surveillance and intercom
• multi-split air conditioning system
• fiber optic internet
• fire protection system
• central water heating
• backup technical systems
PREMIUM CONSTRUCTION STANDARDS
The architecture of the villas combines contemporary aesthetics with natural and quality materials. The exterior features natural stone, while energy-efficient aluminum joinery and large glass surfaces ensure abundant natural light and unobstructed sea views.
The interior is equipped with carefully selected high-quality materials, including oak parquet in the bedrooms, premium ceramics, and sanitary ware from the renowned brand Villeroy & Boch. Each villa features a complete smart technical and security system.
PRIVATE POOL
The private pool is an ideal place for relaxation and enjoyment during warm summer days. It is equipped with a complete system for filtration, lighting, and maintenance, providing owners with a high level of comfort and privacy.
ATTRACTIVE LOCATION
The project is located in a quiet and private environment, while also being well-connected to the most important destinations of the Montenegrin coast:
• 5 minutes to Sveti Stefan
• 10 minutes to Budva
• 30 minutes to Porto Montenegro and Kotor
• about 50 minutes to Tivat airport
• about 50 minutes to Podgorica airport
PAYMENT TERMS
• 5,000 € – reservation
• 10% – upon signing the contract
• 30% – after completion of rough works
• 30% – after completion of fine works
• 30% – upon obtaining the occupancy permit, reduced by the reservation amount
This project represents an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking a luxury residence on the Montenegrin coast, as well as for investors interested in high-profit tourist rentals.
Townhouse C-2 | 295 m² – a blend of contemporary luxury, privacy, and unique views of the Adriatic.

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je luksuzna townhouse vila površine 220 m² sa privatnom parcelom od 154 m² i bazenom, smeštena u prestižnom i mirnom delu Budvanske rivijere – Reževićima. Vila se prostire na tri sprata i potkrovlje i obuhvata pet spavacih soba,pet kupatila, dva prostrana dnevna boravka i dve kuhinje. Panoramski prozori od 2,5 m i visoki plafoni od 3 m stvaraju osećaj prostranosti i obilja prirodne svetlosti, dok dve terase nude nezaboravan pogled na Jadransko more. Na parceli se nalazi privatni bazen, uređeno i ozelenjeno dvorište, kao i parking prostor za dva automobila.
Kupovina ove nekretnine donosi posebne pogodnosti – mogućnost odloženog plaćanja (30% prilikom kupovine, a ostatak u roku od godinu dana), kao i oslobađanje od poreza na prenos vlasništva (3%). Takođe, vlasnici ostvaruju pravo na boravišnu dozvolu u Crnoj Gori.
Ono što ovu nekretninu čini posebnom jeste kombinacija vrhunskog kvaliteta gradnje i savremene opreme. Enterijer krase prirodni kamen, keramika premium klase i moderna stolarija, dok je kuhinja ugrađena i kompletno opremljena. Vila poseduje smart home sistem, optički internet, video nadzor, alarmni sistem, centralni bojler, rezervoar za vodu i bio-septički sistem. Dvorište ima automatizovan sistem za navodnjavanje kojim se upravlja online.
Lokacija nudi savršen balans mira i povezanosti – vila je deo zatvorenog, ograđenog kompleksa u prirodnom okruženju, a istovremeno se nalazi svega 10 minuta vožnje od Budve, 5 minuta od Svetog Stefana, 30 minuta od Kotora, Porto Montenegra i Luštica Bay-a, te 50 minuta od aerodroma u Tivtu i Podgorici. Plaže sa kristalno čistim morem su u neposrednoj blizini, a za ljubitelje zime skijališta su udaljena oko dva sata vožnje. Ova vila predstavlja jedinstvenu priliku za luksuzan porodični život, ali i za unosnu investiciju zahvaljujući velikom potencijalu za izdavanje. Dostupna je kompletna profesionalna usluga održavanja i menadžmenta rentiranja, što omogućava stabilan pasivan prihod.
listing.description_text_en:
For sale is a luxury townhouse villa with an area of 220 m² and a private plot of 154 m² with a swimming pool, located in the prestigious and peaceful part of the Budva Riviera — Reževići.
The villa spreads over three floors and an attic and includes five bedrooms, five bathrooms, two spacious living areas and two kitchens.
Panoramic windows of 2.5 m and high ceilings of 3 m create a feeling of spaciousness and abundance of natural light, while two terraces offer a breathtaking view of the Adriatic Sea. There is a private pool on the plot, a landscaped and green courtyard, as well as parking space for two cars.
Buying this property brings special benefits — the possibility of deferred payment (30% at the time of purchase, the rest within a year), as well as exemption from the property transfer tax (3%). Also, the owners receive the right to a residence permit in Montenegro.
What makes this property special is the combination of top-quality construction and modern equipment. The interior is decorated with natural stone, premium ceramics and modern carpentry, while the kitchen is built-in and fully equipped.
The villa has a smart home system, optical internet, video surveillance, an alarm system, a central boiler, a water tank and a bio-septic system. The courtyard has an automated irrigation system that is controlled online.
The location offers a perfect balance of peace and connectivity — the villa is part of a closed, fenced complex in a natural environment, and at the same time it is only 10 minutes by car from Budva, 5 minutes from Sveti Stefan, 30 minutes from Kotor, Porto Montenegro and Luštica Bay, and 50 minutes from the airport in Tivat and Podgorica. Beaches with crystal clear water are in close proximity, and ski resorts are about two hours away by car.
This villa represents a unique opportunity for a luxurious family life, but also for an attractive investment thanks to its great potential for renting out.

listing.title_text_en: Sale, studio apartment, 54m², Sveti Stefan, Budva
listing.description_text:
Luksuzni studio apartman sa terasom – 298.100 €
Ekskluzivni studio apartman smješten je na jednoj od najatraktivnijih lokacija crnogorskog primorja, između Budve i Svetog Stefana, u okruženju mediteranskog rastinja, maslinjaka i parka Miločer. U okviru privatnog kompleksa površine 10.000 m², ova nekretnina pruža spoj udobnosti, privatnosti i savremenog luksuza.
Apartman raspolaže unutrašnjom površinom od 46,4 m², uz dodatnu terasu od 7,8 m², što čini ukupnu površinu od 54,2 m². Funkcionalan raspored omogućava optimalno korišćenje prostora, dok se mediteranski stil enterijera, prirodni materijali i pažljivo odabrani detalji uklapaju u ambijent luksuznog odmora.
Nekretnina se nalazi u kompleksu koji objedinjuje hotelske usluge sa pet zvjezdica i sadržaje namijenjene opuštanju. Vlasnicima su na raspolaganju spa zona, panoramski bazen sa barom i pogledom na more, uređeni park, organizovan transfer do plaže, kao i usluge konsijerža i obezbjeđenja dostupne 24/7.
Apartman predstavlja zanimljivu opciju za lični boravak na crnogorskom primorju, ali i za investiciju uz mogućnost turističkog izdavanja, u skladu sa uslovima upravljanja.
Cijena: 298.100 €

listing.description_text:
Na prodaju je nova luksuzna vila površine 200 m², smeštena na placu od 330 m² u mirnom i atraktivnom naselju Krašići, u opštini Tivat, svega 10 metara od plaže.
Krašići predstavljaju idealnu lokaciju za one koji traže privatnost, mir i neposrednu blizinu mora, daleko od gradske gužve, uz prelep pogled na Bokokotorski zaliv i okolne planine.
Posebnu vrednost ove vile čine panoramski pogled na more i planine iz svake sobe, privatni bazen i pažljivo osmišljen enterijer, u kojem su spojeni savremeni dizajn, kvalitetni materijali i visok nivo komfora.
Enterijer i opremljenostUnutrašnjost vile autorski je dizajnirana, sa više scenarija ambijentalnog osvetljenja koji prostoru daju poseban karakter. U završnoj obradi korišćene su italijanske keramičke pločice vrhunskog kvaliteta, dok su kupatila opremljena sanitarnom opremom renomiranih brendova Hansgrohe i Villeroy & Boch.
Vila poseduje savremene sisteme klimatizacije i ventilacije, podno grejanje i kamine, što omogućava prijatan boravak tokom cele godine.
Kvalitet gradnje i energetska efikasnostPrilikom izgradnje posebna pažnja posvećena je termoizolaciji i energetskoj efikasnosti. Ugrađeni su prozori sa dvostrukim zastakljenjem i kvalitetnim profilima renomiranog proizvođača Schüco, čime se doprinosi boljoj toplotnoj i zvučnoj izolaciji.
listing.description_text_en:
For sale is a new luxury villa with an area of 200 m², located on a plot of 330 m² in the peaceful and attractive settlement of Krašići, in the municipality of Tivat, just 10 meters from the beach.
Krašići is an ideal location for those who seek privacy, peace and proximity to the sea, far from the hustle and bustle of the city, with a beautiful view of the Boka Bay and the surrounding mountains.
This villa is particularly valuable for its panoramic views of the sea and mountains from every room, a private pool and a carefully designed interior, which combines modern design, quality materials and a high level of comfort.
Interior and equipmentThe interior of the villa is author's designed, with multiple ambient lighting scenarios that give the space a special character. High-quality Italian ceramic tiles were used in the final treatment, while the bathrooms are equipped with sanitary ware from reputable brands Hansgrohe and Villeroy & Boch.
The villa has modern climate control and ventilation systems, underfloor heating and fireplaces, which make it possible to enjoy a pleasant stay throughout the year.
Quality of construction and energy efficiencySpecial attention was paid to thermal insulation and energy efficiency during construction. Double-glazed windows with high-quality profiles from the renowned manufacturer Schüco have been installed, which contribute to better thermal and sound insulation.

The apartment is located on the second floor of a building with an elevator. The building has access from two sides, which is an additional convenience.

The apartment has electric blinds and a multi-split system for heating and cooling, which ensures comfort throughout the year.
The apartment's layout consists of a comfortable hallway with a built-in closet, a storage room, a bathroom, a living room, a kitchen with a dining area, a bedroom, and an east-facing terrace.
A special value of the property is the registered storage room of 7 m², which provides additional storage space.
This property represents an excellent choice for those looking for a well-appointed apartment in a prime location, either for their own living or as an investment for rent.

The apartment consists of a spacious open living room with access to the terrace, a kitchen with a dining area, two bedrooms with access to the terrace, and two bathrooms.
Tivat Hotel&Residences will consist of 33 branded hotel units and 44 residential units distributed in two residential blocks. The hotel complex will have a cafeteria, children’s playground and landscaped park, rooftop pool and bar, restaurant, spa center, and fitness facilities.

Marina Porto Montenegro and the center of Tivat are a 15-minute walk away.
Completion of the works is planned for 2026.
